key_points: Marvell raised its FY28 revenue outlook to $20 billion, a significant increase from prior guidance.
Long‑term vision set at up to $90 billion annual revenue by FY31, driven by AI and data‑center XPU demand.
Stock reacted with a 5‑10% intraday gain on the news, reflecting strong investor optimism.
TD Cowen upgraded Marvell to ‘Buy’, citing XPU risk largely de‑risked after the investor day.
Multiple outlets highlighted the guidance boost as the primary catalyst for the move.
